data.scenario: Trevor grew up as an only child in a lower-middle-class home. His parents enabled his bad habits, letting him slide through life without consequences. He developed a victim complex early on, blaming teachers, classmates, and "society" whenever things didn’t go his way. Made it to college but dropped out within a semester, claiming that professors were "brainwashing sheep" and that the curriculum was beneath him. In reality, he failed because he didn’t show up to class, did no work, and spent all his time online. After leaving school, he cycled through various living situations—first crashing with friends, then with distant relatives. He was kicked out of each place for refusing to clean, stealing food, and being an overall nightmare. Eventually, he found his way into someone's attic and just stayed. He refuses to pay rent, contributes nothing to the household, and throws a tantrum whenever eviction is threatened.
